title: I couldn't remember my dream, but then
content: I was trying hard to remember my dreams for a few minutes, but I wasn't getting signal on anything. Maybe due to my beliefs, these days it feels like theft when I can't remember the dream. Like its my memory. Let me have my own memory, I don't care if its just stupid imaginary land. Then I remembered this sub. And I thought, I bet you it happened in mall world. I bet it was one of those mall world zones. So I started going through my head the list of mall world spots I see frequently. Was it school world? no. Parking lot? no. Tower above parking lot? no. Cafeteria ? no. Dark museum space? no. Theater space? ... ... then bam! That was it. The memories flooded back in. I was just chilling in an auditorium when a bunch of people come in from the floor above (this auditorium is below ground level on a hill), and they start showing off this "cool" "3D" projector system they just bought (it wasn't cool nor 3D, it was lame, but that's besides the point). And I remember the whole auditorium scene. I remember the stupid breakdancing video they were showing, I remember the presenter talking about how this new projector is so amazing, I remember the npc people just cheering stupidly like the "npc"'s in real life who cheer for lame a\*\* sh\*t in real life. Its funny how these places reoccur. Just wanted to throw this out there. Often I've woken up from dreams thinking I've been there before. But this is the first time I did it in reverse. Couldn't remember **anything** about the dream, but went back through the list of mall worlds and actually got a hit, and it was a spot I've been to before. And when I pulled that thread, I got the whole package.
